VBO:0200418.summary: Standard Dachshunds are typically bold, lively and persistent, with a willingness to follow scent and keep working when the job becomes difficult. Developed for hunting above and below ground, they can track, flush and retrieve as well as enter burrows. Standard denotes the larger size, which includes smooth, long-haired and wire-haired dogs rather than a single coat type.
VBO:0200418.shortDescription: A bold, persistent scent hunter, the standard Dachshund belongs to the larger size across all three coat varieties.

sources.title: Dachshund Club of America — Official Standard
sources.evidence: DCA Temperament and General Appearance support bold/lively/persistent hunting character and keen scent work; size/coats paragraphs explicitly include standard size and all three coats.

sources.title: Dachshund Club of America — Dachshund History
sources.evidence: DCA One of a Kind supports going to ground, tracking, flushing and retrieving; these are breed work skills rather than guaranteed individual performance.

sources.title: United Kennel Club — Dachshund standard
sources.evidence: UKC Characteristics supports perseverance/alert response and underground work; Varieties explicitly states standards and miniatures occur in all three coats. No precise size thresholds transferred across registry schemes.
